findings.title: Blob public access is permitted
findings.description: Account-level anonymous blob access can expose data publicly.
findings.recommendation: Disable account-level blob public access unless anonymous access is explicitly required.

findings.title: Modern TLS version enforced
findings.description: Legacy TLS versions provide weaker transport security.
findings.recommendation: Require TLS 1.2 or newer for storage traffic.

findings.title: Secure transfer is not enforced
findings.description: HTTP traffic should not be accepted for storage operations.
findings.recommendation: Require HTTPS-only traffic for the storage account.

findings.title: Storage account has public network access enabled
findings.description: Public network access is not automatically a vulnerability and should match business needs.
findings.recommendation: Review public network access according to business requirements.

findings.title: Key Vault public network access is enabled
findings.description: Public access should be considered carefully for sensitive vault workloads.
findings.recommended_value: Restricted access, firewall rules, or private endpoint
findings.recommendation: Review whether public access is required and prefer firewall restrictions or private endpoints for sensitive workloads.

findings.title: Purge protection is disabled
findings.description: Without purge protection, deleted important vault data may be harder to recover.
findings.recommendation: Enable purge protection for important production vaults to reduce the risk of irreversible deletion.

findings.title: SSH exposed to the Internet
findings.description: NSG nsg-cspm-insecure, rule Allow-SSH-Internet, priority 100; protocol TCP, source *, destination port 22.
findings.recommendation: Restrict SSH to trusted source addresses, VPN connectivity, or Azure Bastion.

findings.title: RDP exposed to the Internet
findings.description: NSG nsg-cspm-insecure, rule Allow-RDP-Internet, priority 110; protocol TCP, source *, destination port 3389.
findings.recommendation: Restrict RDP access to approved administration networks or use Azure Bastion.
